Test_Case_Name: Open Everest COC workflow for eligible risk
Preconditions: Authorized user is signed in; eligible risk jurisdiction and transaction type are configured
Test_Steps: 1. Open the transaction workspace|2. Start an Everest COC transaction|3. Review the available workflow and product options
Expected_Results: 1. Transaction workspace is displayed|2. Everest COC transaction can be started|3. Applicable configured options are displayed
UI_Elements: Transaction workspace (selector TBD); Start transaction control (selector TBD); Product options (selector TBD)
Test_Data: Risk: configured eligible risk; Jurisdiction: configured eligible jurisdiction; Transaction type: configured transaction type
Post_Conditions: New Everest COC transaction is ready to complete
Notes: Exact eligibility values are TBD

Test_Case_Name: Enter valid risk and COC information
Acceptance_Criteria: AC3 Capture Risk and COC Information
Preconditions: Authorized user has an open new Everest COC transaction
Test_Steps: 1. Enter valid applicant and insured details in the corresponding fields|2. Enter valid contact and risk location details|3. Enter valid risk description and COC information|4. Continue to the next workflow step
Expected_Results: 1. Applicant and insured values are accepted|2. Contact and location values are accepted|3. Risk and COC values are accepted|4. Workflow advances without blocking validation errors
UI_Elements: Applicant or insured name field (label; selector TBD); Contact information fields (labels; selectors TBD); Risk location field (label; selector TBD); Risk description field (label; selector TBD); COC fields (labels; selectors TBD); Continue control (selector TBD)
Test_Data: Use valid values that conform to configured Everest rules; COC dates and status: configured valid values
Post_Conditions: Valid entered information is available in the transaction
Notes: Field names and permitted values require confirmation

Test_Case_Name: Resume a saved Everest COC transaction
Acceptance_Criteria: AC2 Start or Resume a Transaction
Preconditions: Authorized user has a previously saved Everest COC transaction
Test_Steps: 1. Open the transaction list|2. Locate and open the saved Everest COC transaction|3. Review the restored fields and current workflow step
Expected_Results: 1. Transaction list is displayed|2. Saved transaction opens|3. Previously saved information and workflow state are restored
UI_Elements: Transaction list (selector TBD); Search or filter control (selector TBD); Saved transaction row (selector TBD); COC fields (labels; selectors TBD)
Test_Data: Transaction: saved Everest COC transaction with previously entered data
Post_Conditions: Saved transaction remains available for continued work
Notes: Use a transaction created in the test environment

Test_Case_Name: Save valid COC information
Acceptance_Criteria: AC3 Capture Risk and COC Information; AC8 Complete Transaction
Preconditions: Authorized user has entered valid required information in an open transaction
Test_Steps: 1. Select Save on the transaction|2. Wait for save confirmation|3. Reopen or refresh the transaction using the supported workflow|4. Review the saved fields
Expected_Results: 1. Save action is available|2. A visible save confirmation or saved status is shown|3. Transaction reopens successfully|4. Saved values are displayed accurately
UI_Elements: Save control (selector TBD); Save status or confirmation (selector TBD); Transaction list (selector TBD); COC fields (labels; selectors TBD)
Test_Data: Transaction: valid Everest COC transaction with completed required fields
Post_Conditions: Transaction is saved and can be resumed
Notes: Exact save feedback text is TBD

Test_Case_Name: Block continuation when required information is missing
Preconditions: Authorized user has an open transaction with required fields configured
Test_Steps: 1. Leave a configured required field empty|2. Select Continue|3. Review the field and workflow state
Expected_Results: 1. Required field remains empty|2. Continuation is blocked when the missing field is blocking|3. A clear field-level validation message identifies the missing information
UI_Elements: Required field under test (label; selector TBD); Continue control (selector TBD); Validation message (selector TBD)
Test_Data: Required field: one field configured as mandatory; Value: empty
Post_Conditions: Transaction remains on the current step until the blocking error is resolved
Notes: Repeat for each field confirmed as required

Test_Case_Name: Reject a value with invalid configured format
Preconditions: Authorized user has an open transaction with format validation configured for the selected field
Test_Steps: 1. Enter a value that violates the configured format in the selected field|2. Move focus out of the field or select Continue|3. Review validation feedback
Expected_Results: 1. Invalid value is entered for validation|2. Validation runs at the configured interaction point|3. Field-level error is displayed and blocking progression is prevented when required
UI_Elements: Field under test (label; selector TBD); Validation message (selector TBD); Continue control (selector TBD)
Test_Data: Field value: configured invalid format for the selected field
Post_Conditions: Invalid value is not accepted for completion
Notes: Exact format rules and validation trigger are TBD

Test_Case_Name: Reject a COC date outside configured date rules
Preconditions: Authorized user has an open transaction and COC date constraints are configured
Test_Steps: 1. Enter a date outside the configured allowed range|2. Move focus out of the date field or select Continue|3. Review the date field and error message
Expected_Results: 1. Date value is entered|2. Date validation runs|3. Date is flagged with a clear message and blocking progression is prevented when configured
UI_Elements: COC effective or completion date field (label; selector TBD); Validation message (selector TBD); Continue control (selector TBD)
Test_Data: Date: configured disallowed date
Post_Conditions: Transaction remains incomplete until a permitted date is entered
Notes: Allowed date range is TBD

Test_Case_Name: Flag inconsistent COC date values
Preconditions: Authorized user has an open transaction with related COC date fields and a configured relationship rule
Test_Steps: 1. Enter COC dates that violate the configured date relationship|2. Select Continue|3. Review the affected date fields and workflow state
Expected_Results: 1. Date values are entered|2. Cross-field validation runs|3. Related fields are identified and progression is blocked when the rule is blocking
UI_Elements: COC effective date field (label; selector TBD); COC expiry date field (label; selector TBD); Validation message (selector TBD); Continue control (selector TBD)
Test_Data: Dates: values configured to violate the confirmed relationship rule
Post_Conditions: Transaction remains incomplete until date values satisfy the configured rule
Notes: Date relationship must be confirmed before execution

Test_Case_Name: Display configured underwriting referral or decline outcome
Preconditions: A test risk is configured to trigger a referral or decline outcome
Test_Steps: 1. Enter the configured referral or decline test data|2. Submit the information for evaluation|3. Review the displayed outcome and next-step instructions
Expected_Results: 1. Configured test data is accepted for evaluation|2. System evaluates the transaction|3. Appropriate referral or decline outcome and configured message are displayed
UI_Elements: Risk and COC fields (labels; selectors TBD); Continue or Evaluate control (selector TBD); Outcome message or status (selector TBD)
Test_Data: Risk data: configured referral or decline scenario
Post_Conditions: Transaction displays the configured underwriting outcome
Notes: Specific trigger data and outcome wording are TBD

Test_Case_Name: Prevent completion while blocking referral is unresolved
Acceptance_Criteria: AC5 Eligibility and Underwriting Outcome; AC8 Complete Transaction
Preconditions: Transaction is in a referral state with required action not completed
Test_Steps: 1. Open the referred transaction|2. Attempt the configured completion action before resolving the referral|3. Review the outcome and transaction status
Expected_Results: 1. Referral status and required action are displayed|2. Completion is blocked while configured blocking referral remains unresolved|3. Transaction remains in referral or pending status with next-step guidance
UI_Elements: Referral status (selector TBD); Completion action (selector TBD); Validation or referral message (selector TBD)
Test_Data: Referral: configured unresolved blocking referral
Post_Conditions: Transaction cannot complete until required action is resolved
Notes: Whether every referral blocks completion depends on configured rules

Preconditions: Allowed COC date range is configured and transaction is open
Test_Steps: 1. Enter the earliest permitted COC date|2. Complete other required fields with valid data|3. Continue to the next workflow step

Test_Case_Name: Accept the latest permitted COC date

Expected_Results: 1. Boundary date is accepted as input|2. Other valid values are accepted|3. No date validation error is displayed and workflow advances when all required data is valid

Test_Case_Name: Accept the configured maximum risk description length

Test_Steps: 1. Enter a risk description at the configured maximum permitted length|2. Move focus out of the field|3. Continue with other valid required data

Test_Case_Name: Accept configured minimum and maximum COC limits
Acceptance_Criteria: AC3 Capture Risk and COC Information; AC4 Field and Cross-Field Validation

Test_Steps: 1. Enter the configured minimum permitted limit and validate the field|2. Replace it with the configured maximum permitted limit|3. Continue with other valid required data
Expected_Results: 1. Minimum permitted value is accepted|2. Maximum permitted value is accepted|3. No range validation error blocks progression for either allowed boundary

Test_Case_Name: Navigate COC fields using keyboard focus
Acceptance_Criteria: AC3 Capture Risk and COC Information
Preconditions: Authorized user has opened the COC information step
Test_Steps: 1. Place keyboard focus in the first COC input|2. Use Tab to move through visible COC controls|3. Enter a valid value in a focused editable field|4. Review focus position and entered value
Expected_Results: 1. First input receives visible focus|2. Focus moves through controls in the displayed order|3. Field accepts the entered value|4. Focus remains visible and value is retained
UI_Elements: COC inputs and controls (labels; selectors TBD)
Test_Data: Valid COC test value: configured permitted value

Test_Case_Name: Retain field value after focus changes
Acceptance_Criteria: AC3 Capture Risk and COC Information
Preconditions: Authorized user has opened a transaction with editable COC fields
Test_Steps: 1. Enter a valid value in a COC field|2. Move focus to another field|3. Return focus to the original field|4. Verify the displayed value
Expected_Results: 1. Value is accepted|2. Focus changes to the next field|3. Original field can be revisited|4. Entered value remains displayed

Test_Data: COC field: configured valid test value

Test_Case_Name: Attach required supporting documentation
Preconditions: Transaction is open and supporting document upload is configured for the scenario
Test_Steps: 1. Open the supporting documentation control|2. Select a permitted test document|3. Confirm or complete the upload|4. Review the attachment list

Test_Case_Name: Clear validation feedback after correcting a field

Test_Steps: 1. Enter an invalid value in a configured field|2. Trigger validation|3. Replace the value with a permitted value|4. Trigger validation again
Expected_Results: 1. Invalid value is entered|2. Field-level validation is displayed|3. Corrected value is accepted|4. Stale error feedback clears or updates and progression follows the configured rule

Test_Data: First value: configured invalid value; Corrected value: configured valid value

Test_Case_Name: Navigate from transaction start to COC information

Test_Case_Name: Return to a saved transaction from the transaction list

Test_Steps: 1. Navigate to the transaction list|2. Select the saved Everest COC transaction|3. Confirm the transaction detail view opens
Expected_Results: 1. Transaction list is displayed|2. Selected transaction opens|3. User can continue from the restored transaction view

Test_Data: Transaction: saved Everest COC transaction

Test_Steps: 1. Leave one configured required field empty while completing other required fields|2. Select Continue|3. Record the field-level message and blocked state|4. Repeat for each configured required field

UI_Elements: Configured required fields (labels; selectors TBD); Continue control (selector TBD); Validation message (selector TBD)
Test_Data: For each iteration: one required field empty; all other required values valid

Test_Case_Name: Validate contact field format

Test_Steps: 1. Enter a contact value that does not match the configured format|2. Move focus out of the field or continue|3. Review the contact field feedback
Expected_Results: 1. Invalid contact value is entered|2. Configured validation is triggered|3. Field-level message is shown and progression is blocked if the field is blocking

Test_Data: Contact value: configured invalid format

Test_Case_Name: Validate COC date relationship rules

Test_Steps: 1. Enter valid values in the completed workflow fields|2. Select Save or the configured save action|3. Leave the transaction|4. Reopen it from the transaction list

Test_Steps: 1. Open the referred transaction|2. Review the referral reason and required action|3. Complete the configured action|4. Re-evaluate or continue the transaction
